name: HiddenCry
statement: Security research, one coordinated disclosure at a time.
summary: Discover security flaws in applications and manage responsible disclosure processes in alignment with vendor remediation timelines.

content.value: The work so far sits in application code that trusts the wrong boundary: a formula passed to eval, a session that outlives the account, a token left behind when a user is disabled, a password stored with a broken hash.

Each CVE keeps the original markdown notes in the repository and a typed article for the site. Screenshots stay next to the write-up. Proofs are the ones already published with the coordinated disclosure.
